$comment: PLACEHOLDER anatomical end ranges, for Tony to set. Each joint motion stops here in the simulation and in Motion Lab's sliders: min = end range in the − direction (e.g. scapular depression), max = in the + direction (e.g. elevation). A motion can't go past anatomy, so only the side a form error can exceed needs a Tier 1 check (Tony, 2026-10-10). Values are rough textbook active ranges, not clinical norms for this app; null = no anatomical stop (segment angles such as trunk vs vertical, or not set yet). Units follow joints/catalogue.ts.

trunk_flexion.why: Trunk line vs vertical mixes hip and spine motion, so it has no single end range.

scapular_elevation.why: PLACEHOLDER: depression ~3 cm, elevation ~8 cm from rest (shoulder joint centre along the trunk line).

scapular_protraction.why: PLACEHOLDER: retraction ~3 cm, protraction ~6 cm from rest.

scapular_upward_rotation.why: PLACEHOLDER: total from rest (rhythm + keyed deviation). Downward kept at −20 so Tony's narrow underhand bottom (−17) fits; textbook downward rotation from rest is smaller.

shoulder_elevation.why: PLACEHOLDER: arm at the side to straight overhead.

shoulder_plane_of_elevation.why: PLACEHOLDER: ~45° horizontal abduction behind the frontal plane to ~130° horizontal adduction across the body.

elbow_flexion.why: PLACEHOLDER: full extension to ~150° active flexion (hyperextension not simulated).
